author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a massive story today of how the Director of the FBI just had an email account leak out. Lot's of noise surrounding this and frankly I just want to see what the truth is. There's a lot to dissect here so sit back, relax and let's see how a new hacker group is going on quite the tear. Thanks for watching!

title: The FBI Director's Emails Just Got Hacked...
